Priya: pausing now.
deploy-bot: canary group D paused for preview-routing-v2 at 08:18 UTC
Leah: starting replay: `./shadow_replay --topic=preview-shadow --shards=200-205 --from=2026-03-23T07:55:00Z --idemp=true`
ingest-bot: replay job 11021 queued, ETA ~2.5m
Leah: replay finished, validation: `SELECT count(*) FROM previews WHERE route_id IS NULL AND ts > now() - interval '20 minutes'` -> 2 (was 78)
Priya: remaining ones look like old tombstones. previews for northstar now show route_id.
Omar: followups: 1) add rollout gate if partition_key changes without `shadow-compat=true`; 2) console alert for preview/invoice route_id mismatch > 0.4% over 10m; 3) small e2e that emits fanout session and validates route attr across both keys.
